precondition_space.delivery_evidence_rule: missing exactly when may_have_replied is false and ack is null; every other schema-valid pair is ok
precondition_space.metadata_rule: consistent no_candidate_block uses null identity, digest, and kind; empty markers; and either user/rank-0 or all-null role/rank. Consistent direct_scalar or text_block uses a non-null identity and digest, user role, text kind, and rank 0. All other schema-valid metadata is inconsistent.
precondition_space.candidate_scope_rule: derive absent from row=absent; derive placeholder from row=present and all occupancy counts zero regardless of lineage_relation; derive occupied when any of source_uploads_live, attempts_prepared_or_later, in_edges, or out_edges is nonzero

r47_model_seed.note: The world every R47 sequence starts from: P holds one SEALED receipt and S holds a placeholder row with zero occupancy. Identities, fingerprints and surface digests are authored specimens; r47_specimen_preimages records the preimage of each authored digest.

r47_specimen_preimages.use: declared source-segment upload digest; these sequences transfer no chunk, because the fence decides at begin
declared source-segment upload digest for the post-adoption attempt

r47_sequences.name: adoption followed by exact E1 replay returns the stored edge without a second adoption or counter effect
r47_sequences.note: Both steps are executed against one store: the second redeem sees the scope the first one wrote.

steps.note: the replay mints no second edge and advances no generation

r47_sequences.name: scope.open after adoption returns the existing DTO with the predecessor lineage and created false
r47_sequences.note: ScopeResult gains no field for the adoption: the rebound row is simply what the existing OPENED arm reports.

r47_sequences.name: pre-adoption ticket is a gateway-local fact and remote prepare, source upload and resolve apply the generation fence
r47_sequences.note: Each step is an independent probe of the arrival check against the shared store, not one gateway transcript: the stale ticket is offered to both ticket-bearing families (prepare and lineage.begin) and then closed by attempt.resolve, and a ticket sampled after the adoption is offered to the same two.

steps.note: the placeholder row before the adoption
the sample writes no row and moves no generation; the bind that follows it is gateway-local (R47b)
the adoption rebinds the lineage and advances the generation 6 -> 7
PrepareResult carries the proof inside attempt_outcome; it has no top-level kind or negative
the source-segment upload carries the same stale ticket and is refused, but BeginResult has no placement for a negative proof, so it refuses plainly and the proof stays with prepare/resolve
clause 8 returns the outcome, the P fence and the generations, so the terminal refusal rides in RESOLVED.attempt_outcome and never as UNKNOWN; R1 keeps the generation unbumped at 7
a ticket sampled after the adoption carries the advanced generation
the fresh ticket passes the arrival check; a live source upload is occupancy under S
the new attempt is never re-ticketed from the stale one; it prepares normally

bounded_outcome.unmodelled_wire_result: an admitted prepare seals, and a SEALED AttemptOutcome carries a whole ReceiptV1 that no R47 vector authors; the model records the admission as occupancy and stops there

r47_sequences.name: concurrent scope.open linearizes before adoption and returns the complete old row
r47_sequences.note: The same two operations in the two possible orders; S04 opens first, S05 adopts first.

r47_sequences.name: concurrent scope.open linearizes after adoption and returns the complete rebound row
r47_sequences.note: Neither order can observe a half-applied row: the lineage and the generation move together.

r47_sequences.name: scope-keyed capacity upload neither occupies the placeholder nor loses usability after adoption
r47_sequences.note: The staging is begun and fed before the adoption and finished and consumed after it, so both halves of R47c are executed: it is not occupancy, and the generation advance does not strand it.

steps.note: no ticket and no attempt: the staging is keyed on (P, agent, incarnation) alone
every occupancy count is still zero, so the placeholder is adopted with the staging in place
the advanced generation does not reach the scope-keyed staging
the first check consumes the staged bytes

bounded_outcome.unmodelled_wire_result: a CHECKED result carries CapacityEstimateV1, whose token algebra is pinned by capacity-estimate-vectors-v1.json; this model decides authorization and consumption only
